label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is user-controlled param from Referer header. Data flow: request.getHeaders('Referer') → headers.nextElement() → param → URLDecoder.decode(param) → doSomething(request, param) → bar = param (condition (500/42)+196=207>200 always true) → obj={'a',bar} → response.getWriter().printf(..., obj). No HTML encoding/sanitization occurs before the sink. Setting X-XSS-Protection to 0 disables browser protection instead of mitigating the vulnerability.

evidence.note: User-provided Referer header extracted and decoded into param
doSomething assigns param to bar because (500/42)+196=207>200 is always true
bar written to response via printf without HTML encoding
